title: Workely owner pricing setup
description: One service an owner sells, plus the pricing rules that build its price. Mirrors the types of Workely's deterministic quote calculator: a base price, then rules applied in priority order, then a job minimum, then times quantity. All money in rules is integer cents.

description.description: Free text for humans. Not read by the calculator.

rules.description: Rules for this service. Applied lowest priority number first.

tax_rate.description: Sales tax as a fraction, for example 0.05 for 5 percent. Applied to taxable lines only.

price_unit.description: How the service is priced. 'flat' means the base price is the price. Any other unit (for example per_sqft, per_panel) starts the base at 0 and lets a per_unit rule build the price. Known values in Workely: flat, per_sqft, per_panel.

price.description: Display price in dollars. For 'flat' this is the base price; for per-unit services it is the rate shown to the owner and the real rate lives in a per_unit rule.

taxable.description: Only an explicit false exempts the line from sales tax.

min_cents.description: Job minimum in cents, stored in the service settings by the setup flow.

condition.description: Optional gate. The rule applies only when the condition matches the extracted input named by input_key. An empty object or null always matches.

effect.description: multiplier: price x factor. flat_add: price + amount_cents. per_unit: price + amount_cents x (the input named by input_key). override: price becomes amount_cents. set_minimum: the job floor becomes amount_cents.

applies_to.description: In Workely's database a rule with no service_id applies to every service.

input_key.description: The extracted input the rule reads, for example sqft, stories, panels.

amount_cents.description: Integer cents, for effect = flat_add, per_unit, override or set_minimum.
